title: Supported quasi-coherent derived category has a perfect generator
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let T be a closed subset of X such that X\setminus T is quasi-compact. The full subcategory D_{\mathrm{QCoh},T}(X) of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category] consisting of objects whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T is a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] generated, in the sense of [def-pc-generators], by a single perfect complex E [def-pc-perfect-complex] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T.

proof.text: Affine case X=\operatorname{Spec}(A). The quasi-compact open X\setminus T is a finite union of standard opens D(f_1),\ldots,D(f_r), so T=V(f_1,\ldots,f_r). Let K be the Koszul complex on f_1,\ldots,f_r, a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X). Multiplication by each f_i is homotopic to zero on K (Stacks Tag 0663), so its cohomology modules are killed by (f_1,\ldots,f_r) and the cohomology sheaves of K vanish on every D(f_i): K is supported on T. Apply the Koszul orthogonality criterion [lem-pc-perfect-generation-koszul-orthogonal] to the scheme X with affine open V=X and open U=X\setminus T (so U\cap V=U is quasi-compact and V\setminus U=T=V(f_1,\ldots,f_r)). If E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) is supported on T and \operatorname{Hom}(K[n],E)=0 for all n, then E\cong Rj_*(E|_U)=Rj_*(0)=0. By [def-pc-generators], K generates the supported subcategory.

Induction. Cover the quasi-compact X by affine opens W_1,\ldots,W_m and induct on m; m=1 is Step 1. For m>1 put U=W_1\cup\cdots\cup W_{m-1} and V=W_m=\operatorname{Spec}(B). U is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, T\cap U is closed in U, and U\setminus T=U\cap(X\setminus T) is quasi-compact because X is quasi-separated. The induction hypothesis gives a perfect P on U supported on T\cap U which generates the supported subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U).

Apply the supported perfect-map lifting statement [lem-sc-perfect-support-map-lift] to X, the quasi-compact open U, the closed T (with X\setminus T quasi-compact), the object E=0 and the zero map \alpha:P\to 0. It gives a perfect Q on X supported on T such that P is a direct summand of Q|_U.

Let Z=X\setminus U, closed in X and contained in V. The open W=V\setminus(Z\cap T)=(U\cap V)\cup(V\setminus T) is quasi-compact, both pieces being intersections of quasi-compact opens of the quasi-separated X; hence Z\cap T=V(g_1,\ldots,g_s) for finitely many g_i\in B. Let K be the Koszul complex on the g_i over B; as in Step 1 it is perfect on V and supported on Z\cap T. Since Z\cap T is closed in X and contained in V, the supported-open pushforward statement [lem-pc-supported-open-pushforward] for i:V\to X makes K'=Ri_*K perfect on X and identifies it with the extension by zero i_!K; hence the cohomology sheaves of K' vanish off Z\cap T\subset T. Thus Q\oplus K' is perfect and supported on T.

Let E be in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), supported on T, with \operatorname{Hom}((Q\oplus K')[n],E)=0 for all n. Since K'\cong i_!K and i_!\dashv i^{-1} with both exact [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], \operatorname{Hom}(K[n],E|_V)=0 for all n. The Koszul orthogonality criterion [lem-pc-perfect-generation-koszul-orthogonal], applied to the scheme V with open W and affine open V (W\cap V=W quasi-compact, V\setminus W=Z\cap T=V(g_1,\ldots,g_s)), shows E|_V\to R(W\to V)_*(E|_W) is an isomorphism. Now E|_W is supported on T\cap W=T\cap U\cap V, closed in W and contained in U\cap V, so [lem-pc-supported-open-pushforward] for U\cap V\to W gives E|_W\cong R(U\cap V\to W)_*(E|_{U\cap V}); with [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition], E|_V\to R(U\cap V\to V)_*(E|_{U\cap V}) is an isomorphism. Let j:U\to X and F=Rj_*(E|_U) with unit E\to F. By [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] (for j and the opens V and U), F|_V\cong R(U\cap V\to V)_*(E|_{U\cap V}) and F|_U\cong E|_U, and under these the unit restricts to the isomorphism above on V and to the identity on U. A morphism that is an isomorphism on each member of an open cover is an isomorphism (its cone has zero cohomology sheaves), so E\cong Rj_*(E|_U).

By the adjunction between restriction and derived direct image, \operatorname{Hom}(Q[n],E)=\operatorname{Hom}(Q|_U[n],E|_U), which contains \operatorname{Hom}(P[n],E|_U) as a direct summand; so these groups vanish. E|_U lies in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U) and is supported on T\cap U, so the choice of P (Step 2) gives E|_U=0, and Step 5 gives E\cong Rj_*(0)=0. By [def-pc-generators], Q\oplus K' generates the supported subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), completing the induction.

The supported objects form a triangulated full subcategory: shifts preserve support, and in a distinguished triangle the long exact cohomology sequence shows that the third cohomology sheaf is supported on T when the first two are. Thus the perfect object E from the preceding steps generates the stated triangulated supported subcategory.

lean.statement: theorem supported_perfect_generator (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ) : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : schemeDerivedCategory X ↦ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K ∧ ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ∃ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X E.obj ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E.obj).val.presheaf x))) ∧ ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K.obj).val.presheaf x))) → (IsZero K.obj ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj))

reviewed_lean.note: X qcqs (CompactSpace/QuasiSeparatedSpace), T closed, X\T qc (IsCompact Tᶜ as landed map-lift); D_QCoh,T = schemeDerivedQCohProperty + STATE stalkwise support; triangulated = ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated of that property (no letI); single E in D_QCoh perfect, supported on T, generator = shifted-Hom zero-detection over supported K (sibling C1 67d66a7a5 form); dropped def-pc-supported-derived-category (second spelling of support: restriction-to-open vs STATE stalkwise); dropped duplicate new node(s) def-pc-supported-derived-category (--drop-nodes; not merged, the item points at the landed declaration)
